caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure, possibly a statue or a sculpted figure, facing slightly to the viewer's left. The figure is shown with dark brown hair tied back, brown skin, and is draped in a greenish cloak or shawl over one shoulder, which wraps around the torso and is held at the chest with one hand. The clothing underneath consists of a reddish-brown shirt with mid-length sleeves and a loose, knee-length yellow and ochre skirt or tunic with vertical patterns. The legs are colored with white and yellow tones, and the feet are positioned on a rectangular pedestal or base. The cloak shows areas of green, turquoise, and gold, with visible textured brush strokes. The head is adorned with a narrow headband. The lower part of the figure and the pedestal are unfinished, with some sketch lines visible and minimal color applied. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned.
title: Figurehead: Indian
